name: set_timer
description: Set a timer for the specified duration or end time.

time_human.description: The duration or target end time to set the timer for in human readable format e.g. '1 hour and 30 minutes', '45 minutes', 'for 1:50pm', 'at 13:30'.

name: set_alarm
description: Set an alarm for a specified time.

time_hours.description: The hour component of the alarm time (24 hour time).

time_minutes.description: The minute component of the alarm time (0-59).

label.description: An optional label or title for the alarm.

name: create_reminder
description: Create a reminder for the user at a specific time.

message.description: The message to remind the user e.g. 'Buy more milk'.

date_time_human.description: If provided by the user, the date and/or time to remind the user in human readable format e.g. 'tomorrow at 13:00', 'next Monday at 9am', 'on July 5th at 14:30', 'at 3pm'.

name: create_list_item
description: Create a new item in the user's list (e.g a shopping list, todo list) with an optional reminder time.

list_name.description: The name of the list to add the item to e.g. 'shopping', 'todo'. Use a short search term keyword, e.g. 'shopping' instead of 'my shopping list' to improve matching with existing lists.

message.description: The text of the list item to add.

reminder_date_time_human.description: If provided by the user, the date and/or time to remind the user of the list item in human readable format e.g. 'tomorrow at 13:00'.

name: create_note
description: Create a new note with the given user text.

text.description: The text of the note, usually a direct quote from the user.

name: evaluate_js
description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression and get the resulting console output. Use for calculations, math, date, or string manipulation. Use console.log() to output data.

js.description: The JavaScript code to evaluate and execute.

name: send_instant_message
description: Sends an instant message to a specified contact.

contact_id.description: The unique identifier of the contact to whom the instant message will be sent.

text.description: The instant message contents to be sent to the contact.

name: search_for_contact
description: Searches for a contact in Beeper by name to obtain their contact ID.

name.description: The name of the contact to search for.
